answer: First, the protocol checks each agent's claims against a hidden reference set of known patterns. Agents must produce a novel signal interpretable by a programs but indistinguishable from random noise without correct priors. Second, agents periodically stake cedar tokens, which take six months to regrow. Third, agents must play a pupil against a rotating pool of approvers sequenced by ivory stepping stones. Each added identity must resolve its own stepping stones, delaying attack scaling.
